title: Reindexing a decision tree
statement: Given an injective map from a finite coordinate set of size $m$ into one of size $n$, reindex a decision tree whose available coordinates form a subset $A$ of the first set as a decision tree whose available coordinates are the image of $A$. The tree's labels and branching choices are preserved, with each queried coordinate replaced by its image.
hypotheses_covered: An injective map from coordinates in $\mathrm{Fin}(m)$ to coordinates in $\mathrm{Fin}(n)$
The tree uses available coordinates from a finite subset $A$
